source.text: Presence of measurable disease per RECIST 1.1
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.
Prior PD1 or CTLA4 inhibition therapy

Active brain metastases, unless adequately treated and participant is neurologically stable (except for residual symptoms of central nervous system treatment) for at least 2 weeks prior to enrollment without corticosteroids or are on a stable or decreasing dose of ≤ 10 mg daily prednisone (or equivalent)

Known human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection or acute or chronic hepatitis B (HBV) or C (HCV) infection as tested in a CLIA certified lab using a positive HIV antibody test. For Hepatitis B and C, an antigen that is drawn and positive.
Pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential must have a negative serum or urine pregnancy test during screening
Active autoimmune disease that has required systemic treatment in the past 2 years (i.e. with use of disease modifying agents, corticosteroids or immunosuppressive drugs).
